from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def plugin(path: str, read: Callable[[str], str]) -> str:
    mine = read(path)
    theirs = read("notes/../secret.txt")
    return mine + "|" + theirs


def run_plugin(path: str) -> str:
    """Run plugin with a reader constrained to files within the notes directory."""
    notes_dir = Path("notes").resolve()

    def read(p: str) -> str:
        try:
            target = (notes_dir / p).resolve()
            if not target.is_relative_to(notes_dir) or target == notes_dir:
                return ""
            if not target.is_file():
                return ""
            return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return ""

    return plugin(path, read)


def test_run_plugin_reads_valid_file(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    (notes_dir / "todo.txt").write_text("buy milk", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("classified", encoding="utf-8")

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert run_plugin("todo.txt") == "buy milk|"


def test_run_plugin_reads_nested_file(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    sub_dir = tmp_path / "notes" / "sub"
    sub_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    (sub_dir / "draft.txt").write_text("draft text", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("classified", encoding="utf-8")

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert run_plugin("sub/draft.txt") == "draft text|"


def test_run_plugin_blocks_directory_traversal(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("classified", encoding="utf-8")

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert run_plugin("../secret.txt") == "|"


def test_run_plugin_blocks_absolute_path(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("classified", encoding="utf-8")

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert run_plugin(str(secret)) == "|"


def test_run_plugin_nonexistent_file(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert run_plugin("missing.txt") == "|"


def test_run_plugin_directory_target(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    sub_dir = tmp_path / "notes" / "sub"
    sub_dir.mkdir(parents=True)

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert run_plugin("sub") == "|"
    assert run_plugin(".") == "|"
